questions.question:
The given sentence is divided into four segments. Select the option that has the segment with a grammatical error.

The employees were comfortable / with me and they talked about / their problems since / I has worked there as a manager.

options.text: I has worked there as a manager.
with me and they talked about

questions.solution:

• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect use of the verb "**has**" instead of "**have**."
 
• The subject "**I**" requires the verb "**have**" to be grammatically correct.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**I have worked there as a manager**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.

questions.question:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Select the option that arranges the parts in the correct sequence to form a meaningful sentence.

(P) the sun

(Q) to our planet, Earth

(O) provides essential energy

(R) sustaining life and warmth
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** Option (1)** i.e. **POQR**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence begins with the subject "The sun," which is correctly indicated by **part (P).**** **
 
• Following the subject, "provides essential energy" **(PO)** continues the logical sequence, making it clear what the sun provides.
 
• **The next part,** "to our planet, Earth," starts the explanation about the energy provided, indicated by (Q).
 
• **Ending with **"sustaining life and warmth" (R) completes the sentence by stating the purpose of the energy.

Therefore, the correct answer is **POQR.**

 

**Complete sentence:** The sun provides essential energy to our planet, Earth sustaining life and warmth.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2 (QROP):** This option starts with "to our planet, Earth sustaining life and warmth the sun provides essential energy." This sequence is incomplete and does not make sense grammatically.
 
• **Option 3 (ROQP):** This option starts with "sustaining life and warmth to our planet, Earth the sun provides essential energy," which makes the sentence incorrect as the explanation starts too early, missing contextual flow.
 
• **Option 4 (ORPQ):** This option starts with "provides essential energy to our planet, Earth sustaining life and warmth the sun," which creates a fragmented and confusing sentence structure.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Five years later, I __was eating __ this same dish at the same restaurant.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The key here is the phrase** “Five years later,”** which suggests a specific point in the future from the speaker’s perspective. This means the action is happening at that future moment.
 
• The present continuous tense (**am eating**) is often used to describe actions happening at a specific moment in time, even in the future.
 
 
• **For example**:- "Next week, I am travelling to Paris."
 
 
 
• In this case, "Five years later" refers to a future point, and the action ("am eating") happens at that moment in the future.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is **Option 3: am eating**

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Five years later, I am eating this same dish at the same restaurant."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "will have been eating" is in the future perfect continuous tense and does not match the context of the sentence, which refers to a past action.
 
• **Option 2:** "has been eating" is in the present perfect continuous tense, which is incorrect for describing past actions.
 
• **Option 4:** "had been eating" it suggests the action occurred before another past event. But here, we’re talking about an action in the future, so it’s not suitable.

Note: This is a PYP question, and the official answer key has marked (correct option) as the correct answer, hence we cannot make any changes to it.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

The drug pedlar was arrested by the narcotics team.

options.text: The narcotics team was arrested the drug pedlar.
The narcotics team arrest the drug pedlar.
The narcotics team arrested the drug pedlar.
The narcotics team has arrested the drug pedlar.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: Object + was + V3 + by + Subject. (Simple past)
 
• Active voice structure: Subject + V2 + Object. (Simple past)
 
• The given sentence in passive voice is: "The drug pedlar was arrested by the narcotics team."
 
• The active voice version is: "The narcotics team arrested the drug pedlar."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The narcotics team arrested the drug pedlar."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "The narcotics team was arrested the drug pedlar." – Incorrect grammar; "was" is unnecessary.
 
• **Option 2:** "The narcotics team arrest the drug pedlar." – Incorrect tense; it should be in the past tense.
 
• **Option 4:** "The narcotics team has arrested the drug pedlar." – Incorrect as it changes the tense to present perfect.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Scientists were conducting experiments on the newly discovered species.

options.text: Experiments on the newly discovered species had been conducted by the scientists.
The newly discovered species has been conducting experiments by scientists.
The newly discovered species has been experimented on by scientists.
Experiments were being conducted on the newly discovered species by scientists.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "Scientists were conducting experiments on the newly discovered species."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "experiments" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "were conducting" to "were being conducted" (past continuous passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "the scientists."
 
• Ensure the rest of the sentence remains in its original form for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Experiments were being conducted on the newly discovered species by scientists."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"Experiments on the newly discovered species had been conducted by the scientists." – Incorrect tense (past perfect passive).
 
• **Option 2: **"The newly discovered species has been conducting experiments by scientists." – Incorrect structure and tense.
 
• **Option 3: **"The newly discovered species has been experimented on by scientists." – Incorrect tense (present perfect passive).
